verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a payments platform that holds connected-account and customer data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-purge controls. The pack covers onboarding, payouts, pricing, webhooks, disputes and balances, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
